closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, carb quality, and calcium, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin A, saturated fat, and low magnesium. It is good for muscles and strength sports, practical meals, and bone health because the protein section supports repair and maintenance, the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, and calcium gives the bone-health case something to work with.
